title: Weird experience I have when I’m ‘restless dreaming’, wondering if it’s just me.

classification.question_topic: Asking if others experience repeated very short abstract dreams that force awakening in a half-awake/half-asleep state (“restless dreaming”).
classification.skip_reason: No describable dream locations/scenes; dreams described as extremely short and totally abstract with no spatial/setting details.

meta.initial_emotion: frustrating / weird state of being half-awake/half-asleep (described as frustrating)
meta.final_emotion: terrible next day; feels like never slept at all

interactions.description: Cycle described as: falls asleep → has an extremely short, totally abstract dream that lasts a specified time → dream ends → forced awake → must change sleeping position → falls back asleep → same process repeats ~10–30 times and can go on for hours; feels half-awake/half-asleep and dream blurs reality while in it.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology is primarily sleep-state/time-structure: frequent forced awakenings, looping repetition, half-awake/half-asleep state, reality-blurring. No setting, entities, or navigable environment described; therefore no location/connection extraction.
